whatIsIt.eli5: Takes pieces from several places, makes them the same size, and adds them together.
whatIsIt.simple: Picks one piece from each CBLinear input, resizes them (nearest) to the size of the last input, and adds everything.

whyExists.eli5: It feeds the first backbone's knowledge into the second backbone.
whyExists.simple: It injects features from the first backbone into each stage of the second backbone of YOLOv9-E.
whyExists.engineer: Composite-backbone fusion by addition; no parameters.
